buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

The contractor will have to ensure the wage payment to th e persons employed by them as per prevailing rate of minimum wages of res pective schedules through BANK and will give proof of same to the OFK repr th esentatives nominated for the contract before 7 of every month. In turn, OFK Representatives after confirmation from the Bank will issue a ce rtificate which he should forward with claim bill for release of payment. This s

hould be ensured by the AGENCY irrespective of the fact that OFK has made the payment to the AGENCY or not and whatsoever other reasons. However, OFK will make the monthly payment to the AGENCY after submission of the b ill along with a copy of Wage Payment Sheet, Receipts of Provident Fund and ESIC contribution of each employee by name, for that particular month. Tax deduction at source as per Government rules will be applicable. 7th In case the contractor fails to pay wages/short payment, by of the followi ng month then the OFK, on the basis of certificate issued by paying authority will pay the wages/difference of short payment to the workers employed by c ontractor. The expenditure incurred by the OFK on account of payment of th e wages/difference of short payment to the workers shall be recovered from the bills of the agency along with penalty which will be not less than 5% of bi ll amount. xvii. Payment Terms:-Payment shall be made on submission of, a. 100% payment of Worker Wages will be made on monthly basis on submis sion of following documents: i. Satisfactory Job completion certificate issued by User section rep resentatives. ii. Attendance Sheet (Signed by paying authority) iii. Wage disbursement certificate for payment as certified by payin g authority nominated by OFK the contract after confirmation fr om bank. a. 100% payment toward government contribution of EPF and ESIC (wherever applicable) will be made on actual basis, on submission of EPF and ESIC Cha llan along with copy of EPF and ESIC return and other relevant documents f or payment of ESIC contribution. Along with copy of challan a contribution h istory from ESIC web-site esic.in covering all the labourers in the contract is also to be attached along with contractor bill. b. 100% payment will be made towards Bonus on actual basis as per applicabl e case. c. 100% GST will be reimbursed on submission of GST invoice along wi th relevant documents. d. Monthly payment of worker will be sent to their individual bank acc ount by contractor provider and he will give proof of same to the O th FK representative nominated for the contract before 7 of every month. e. Regarding genuineness of EPF remittance the firm representatives will also have to come to factory and show the details on EPFO web page to factory representative who will take a print out as an evidence. Other payment terms as per a SLA of GeM and uploaded Annexure A f or which these are not defined separately in ATC. xviii. Termination & Penalty Clause :-

a. In case of unsatisfactory performance/service, the contract will be lia ble to be terminated at any time giving 7 days’ notice and forfeiting t he Security Deposit in addition, a penalty up to 10% will also be levie d, at the discretion of Chief General Manager. b. Chief General Manager reserves the right to suspend the contract at any time without assigning any reason. Other penalty terms as per a SLA of GeM and uploaded Annexure A fo r which these are not defined separately in ATC. xix .Option Clause – The buyer reserves the right to increase/decrease the duration up to 50% at the time of placement of contract at the prevailing rate.
